item.description:
### New
- Collection folders now show their author's animated covers and drifting backdrops, playing only while they're on screen. - A collection folder can carry its own hero video, which plays as its header. - A folder opens its catalogs as named tabs, with a merged "All" tab that interleaves them. A source that no longer has an addon behind it is dropped instead of showing a tab that can only fail. - Pressing a tab you're already on takes you back to that tab's top level.
### Bug fixes
- The "Who's watching?" profile picker is centred on wide windows instead of hugging the left edge.
